name: cycling-analytics
description: Private local-first cycling analytics, training guidance, and ride planning.
author: Zach Tolen

scripts.build:desktop: npm run build && npm run build:electron
scripts.dev:electron: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron .
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:desktop && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build:desktop && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --publish never
scripts.test: npm run build && node --import tsx --test tests/coach.test.ts tests/heart-rate.test.ts tests/lthr.test.ts tests/data-quality.test.ts tests/cadence.test.ts tests/comparability.test.ts tests/markdown-export.test.ts tests/metrics.test.ts tests/shared-utils.test.ts tests/api-client.test.ts tests/brouter.test.ts tests/training-load.test.ts tests/recovery.test.ts tests/phase3.test.ts tests/strava-sync.test.ts tests/secret-store.test.ts tests/safe-storage-secret-store.test.ts tests/strava-settings.test.ts tests/electron-security.test.ts tests/electron-oauth.test.ts tests/distribution.test.ts tests/local-server.test.ts tests/rendered-html.test.mjs
